messages:
ivan: Heads-up 11 customer reported an automatic fallback mid-rollout. Console shows a terse banner: 'fallback occurred' and the customer wants a full timeline + a signed invoice breakdown. Can we design a small UX + telemetry gap fix?

sarah: Absolutely. Short list: (1) emit structured fallback_audit events (ordered), (2) emit per-request inference_segment events for model-level token attribution, (3) Console playback that stitches those events and policy snapshot.

leo: Telemetry proto idea (compact): POST /v1/audit/fallback -> event fields: trace_id, time, policy_id, matched_rule, from_model, to_model, operator(auto|human), segments_ref, evidence_ref, attribution_mode. Keep big arrays out of the event payload; point to segments_ref (s3).

marta: UX: small chevron on Rollouts > History opens an inline 'playback' lane. Steps are tiny chips: metric(trigger=value) -> policy(eval) -> decision(auto/human) -> model-switch(+tokens). Each chip can expand for more context and an 'export signed report' button.

ivan: Billing: customer wants a signed per-trace breakdown for disputes. Need GET /v1/billing/trace/{trace_id}/official_breakdown that returns signed CSV/JSON with per-segment tokens + unit rates at serve time, and obeys account redaction/retention rules.

billing-bot: NOTE: official_breakdown requires role.billing.reconcile. Default audit_retention=30 days. Alert: if autofallback-driven model shifts >15% of billed tokens MoM notify account owner.

sarah: Edgecase: prefix replay + KV cache produces mixed attribution. Add attribution_mode values: exact | estimated | mixed_kv and include estimated_share metadata like "40/60". Console shows an "estimate" badge when not exact.

leo: Also add attribution_span_ids so playback can map trace spans to segments (helps explain cache-origin tokens). Example small event (as string in chat): ```json
{
  "event":"inference_segment",
  "trace_id":"t-4100-xyz",
  "segment_index":"0",
  "model_id":"redwood-xl",
  "tokens":"800",
  "attribution_mode":"exact",
  "cache_origin_span":"span-12"
}
```

marta: Compliance: per-account audit_retention_days and redaction_level (none|partial|full). Only principals with role.audit.view_unredacted can see raw evidence. When someone views unredacted audit, emit audit_view event with viewer id + timestamp. Keep audit-view log append-only.

ivan: UX nuance: in Billing > Requests show a stacked bar per-request (segments colored by model). Hover shows tokens, unit price, and a reconcile button that requests the official signed breakdown. If attribution is estimated show the small "estimate" pill and a link to runbook.

ops-bot: Deploy: canary of `fallback-audit-indexer` started at 2026-11-02T09:01Z :rocket:

sarah: Owners: leo (telemetry + indexer), marta (Console playback + export), ivan (product/runbook), billing (billing-bot) for reconcile policies. I'll file RF-9012 with telemetry proto + Console mock.

ivan: Next step: small spike to prove per-segment emitter + a Console mock with a single playback use case. Keep scope tight for sprint. Thanks.
